title: PPG-MS15 — Multi-Process Job Package (mill → grind → EDM in one quote, multi-machine sequencing)
description: Today every PRISM post emits ONE program for ONE machine. Real JM Die jobs touch 4 machines (lathe → wire EDM → mill → grinder) sequentially, each requiring its own post output, setup sheet, and traveler. MS15 owns multi-process job packages: one master ticket spans N machines, each gets its own post + sidecar + setup sheet, and the package carries the inter-machine WCS hand-off plus material allowance plan.
rationale: Coverage scrutiny flagged this as MISSING — `multi_process_route` action exists but no PPG-MS sequences across machine types in one program package. Without it, the operator surface from MS13 only delivers single-machine output; the programmer assembles cross-machine jobs by hand, which is exactly the failure mode this whole roadmap exists to fix.
leverage_existing: multi_process_route + multi_process_analyze + multi_process_sequence + multi_process_cost + multi_process_alternatives + multi_process_consolidate (camDispatcher actions, already exist)
PostProcessorPipelineEngine — emits one machine; MS15 wraps it in a Package Builder
TravelerCreate + TravelerStartSetup + TravelerScan (business dispatcher) — for cross-machine routing tracking
MillTurnLiveTooling + MillTurnSubSpindle + MillTurnMultiChannel + MillTurnSwiss (already wired) — for combo machines (Multus B250IIW from PPG-MS4/U-PPGM33)
Material allowance + stock-allowance + bend-allowance actions for cross-process geometry hand-off

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: Optimas fastener die — 100-piece run through 4 of JM Die's 21 machines: Okuma LB300II (lathe roughing) → Mitsubishi MV1200R (WEDM internal profile) → Hurco V11 (mill external pocket) → centerless grinder (final OD).
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_ms15: Programmer emits 4 separate posts manually. WCS hand-off: each post assumes raw stock from scratch. Material allowance: programmer guesses 0.5 mm grind stock; actual leaves 0.7 mm because lathe finish was rougher than spec. Grind cycle runs 30% over budget. Traveler: hand-written.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_ms15: Wizard accepts the multi-process job. multi_process_route sequences the 4 machines with WCS chain (lathe Z=0 → WEDM origin offset → mill WCS via probe touchpoint → grinder centerless). Material allowance per process auto-computed (lathe→WEDM = 0 mm, WEDM→mill = 0 mm, mill→grind = 0.4 mm). Each machine gets its own post + sidecar + setup sheet. Master traveler carries the routing chain. Single quote.

units.title: MultiProcessPackageBuilderEngine — wraps PostProcessorPipelineEngine for N machines
units.scope: src/engines/MultiProcessPackageBuilderEngine.ts — accepts a multi-process job spec (N machines + sequence); calls multi_process_route to validate; calls PostProcessorPipelineEngine per machine; assembles into one package ZIP with cross-references.

units.title: Inter-machine WCS chain + datum hand-off planner
units.scope: src/engines/InterMachineWCSChainEngine.ts — given the route, plans WCS for each machine such that the previous machine's reference datum is reachable on the next; emits probe macros for re-establishing WCS at each station.

units.title: Cross-process material allowance planner
units.scope: src/engines/CrossProcessAllowancePlannerEngine.ts — computes per-stage stock allowance based on previous-stage finish + next-stage capability (lathe Ra→WEDM kerf, WEDM Ra→mill, mill Ra→grind). Pulls from src/physics/constants.ts surface tables.

units.title: Master traveler integration (TravelerCreate + multi-stage)
units.scope: Wire multi-process package into TravelerCreate; one traveler spans the route; each stage has its own scan + setup + cycle log; aggregated into the parent quote.

units.title: Wizard multi-process mode (route picker + per-stage configurator)
units.scope: web/src/components/ppg/MultiProcessRoutePicker.tsx + per-stage MS6 wizard panels; route validation UI; package preview before generation.

units.title: End-to-end multi-process integration test (4-machine reference job)
units.scope: src/__tests__/MultiProcessJobPackage.e2e.test.ts — exercises Optimas fastener-die reference job through 4 JM Die machines; asserts package contains 4 posts + 4 sidecars + 4 setup sheets + 1 master traveler + cross-references.

completion_criteria: MultiProcessPackageBuilderEngine emits a coherent multi-machine package from a single wizard run
Inter-machine WCS chain validated end-to-end on the 4-machine reference job (Optimas fastener die)
Cross-process allowance computed correctly: predicted vs measured allowance within ±0.05 mm on the reference job
Master traveler aggregates per-stage logs into one quote-cost record
Wizard multi-process mode usable end-to-end in operator UX test (N≥3 programmers)
